verdict.rationale: Being an MCP client is a fair axis for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence never shows Deepgram Voice Agent connecting to external MCP servers. Function calling is a developer building block where 'your application then executes' the action, so it is not MCP-client support. The dg CLI's built-in MCP server is the server role, which belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
